evidence.reason: `render_units` collects every `crq-*` file under the systemd tree recursively (lines 681-684) but later writes by basename only to `output / source.name` (lines 706-708). Two distinct source paths with the same basename therefore render to the same destination; the second `atomic_bytes` silently overwrites the first, and `paths` contains the same path twice. No duplicate-basename check exists before writing. Unique basenames still render normally, so this is a minor correctness fix, not an owner decision.
